deploymentSafety.rollingRestartRisk: When a service is killed, in-flight requests fail with 502. In-memory cache (plans, userSpend) is lost.
deploymentSafety.mitigation: Add process.on('SIGTERM', callback) to drain connections before exit. Add Redis-backed shared cache.

recommendations: Add process.on("SIGTERM", ...) handlers to all services for connection draining
Add Redis-backed shared cache to preserve state across restarts
For zero-downtime: add load balancer health check removal before stopping services
